title: Lady S./Quotes
summary:
"I hope you're not going to tromp half way across the world because a delusional old man handed you a map to who knows where?"
Lady S to Dante Vale (Ladies' Choice)

"It's supposed to be a surprise visit so, you know, try and act surprised."
Lady S to Dante Vale, about Guggenheim visiting (The Divine Comedy)
